labels: inherit only observed source-supported endpoint flags from verified inventory; other cells masked
chapman_group_policy: preserve prior patient proxy partitions; primary source reports one recording per patient; exact source-local and signal screening required
cpsc_group_policy: entire source training only; no certified patient keys, no within-source validation and no patient-level support inference
overlap: screen same-duration resampled aligned lead signatures and exclude both members across additional sources and all extra-source matches to CODE; no ID linkage across providers
balanced_steps: sample equal count of single-source batches per epoch; inverse records per verified source patient
evaluation: same CODE validation rows for all architectures; separate Chapman development matrix for CODE-only zero-shot and other modes; no external confirmation
